name: Husqvarna 435 / 435e
blurb: 13″, 16″ and 18″ bar setups on .325″ chain, .050″ gauge, 56–72 drive links — straight from Husqvarna's 2026 fit-up guide.
intro: The Husqvarna 435 / 435e is a rear-handle gas saw. Husqvarna's own 2026 Bar & Chain Fit-up Guide (effective 1 January 2026) lists 3 approved bar lengths for it (13″, 16″ and 18″), running .325″ pitch chain in .050″ gauge.

bars.note: Husqvarna's 2026 fit-up guide pairs this 13″ setup with bar X-Force 596199756 and chain SP33G X-Cut 581643656.
Husqvarna's 2026 fit-up guide pairs this 16″ setup with bar X-Force 596199766 and chain SP33G X-Cut 581643666.
Husqvarna's 2026 fit-up guide pairs this 18″ setup with bar X-Force 596199772 and chain SP33G X-Cut 581643672.

sources.title: Bar & Chain Fit-up Guide 2026 (effective 1 January 2026) — certified/approved bar and chain combinations per saw

sources_note: Husqvarna 2026 Bar & Chain Fit-up Guide (effective 1 January 2026), read in full on 24 Oct 2026; every row in the table is restated from the saw's entry in that guide.
